title: M3-3 DvP Phase 2: reliability lab (A00, A02-A10, A12) on the repaired FFA targets
objective: Run the specification's Phase A on the validated, R-072-repaired completed-game observations (OWN-074): A00 landscape and raw vs adjusted ranks; A02 split-method sensitivity including 1,000 seeded random balanced splits; A03 opponent-adjustment variants; A04 position stability by era and half size with joint season-bootstrap orderings; A05 variance components (method of moments and REML with unequal game counts, boundary and convergence reported); A06 temporal stability (first vs second half, lag decay, rolling windows); A07 between-season carryover; A08 within-week permutation nulls and cluster-bootstrap comparisons; A09 FFA-component decomposition from the scorer's rule contributions; A10 era, season-exclusion, trimming and influence robustness; A12 refused-line and stat-correction sensitivity. Tables, SVG plots, intervals, RELIABILITY_REPORT and METHODOLOGY; tests T12-T14, T23, T24, T28. Descriptive only: no forecast, no weight change, no production write.

review.summary: Read the specification's Phase A (A00-A12), sections 6-9 and 11 (estimators, unequal halves, clustered resampling, multiple comparisons, required reports and plots, tests T12-T14, T21-T24, T28), the phase 1 code (observations, reliability, provenance, dvp.py) and receipts. Inputs: the audit run phase1-audit-20261124T021910Z observations on repaired index 6ffb62fb (31,668 cells, 31,610 valid) and its schedule. matplotlib and scipy are absent; plots will be deterministic SVG written by the lab, and estimators use numpy (installed). The athlete and D/ST target tables carry per-rule contributions, which allow the FFA-component decomposition (A09) without a new data family; true opportunity counts would need a new realized-statistics source and are left to Phase B/C.

plan.summary: lab.py: position frames (entity = defense, or offense for D/ST; faced = the other side); adjustments none/season/loo_mean/loo_median/loo_shrunk; split assignments calendar/alternating/chronological/first6_next6/home_away/random (numpy, seeded); method-of-moments and REML one-way components with unequal sizes, boundary and convergence; lag-binned ICC; rolling-window correlations with model-implied values; carryover with slope and leave-one-pair-out CV; within-week permutation nulls; season, unit and franchise cluster bootstraps; jackknife influence. svg.py: deterministic plots. provenance: a contributions source spec for A09. dvp.py reliability subcommand writing reliability-results.json, plots and run artifacts; registry records for A00-A10, A12. Tests T12-T14, T23, T24, T28 plus determinism. Then RELIABILITY_REPORT.md and METHODOLOGY.md written from the results.
